origins.name: Alacrity
origins.description: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.

origins.name: One Quiet Moment
origins.description: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

origins.name: Veist Stinger
origins.description: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.
